description: Spot-check the concept map's CORRECTNESS (drift checks freshness; this checks entries were right to begin with). Returns a sample of entries — always the never-verified and least-recently-verified first — with skeletons of their claimed files, for you to judge whether the files actually implement what the entry claims. Report verdicts back via save_verification with each entry’s kind and reviewToken. Tokens bind the entry and bounded source evidence; changed evidence requires a fresh review. Run periodically, or after an automated refresh wrote entries no human reviewed.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

name: verify_snapshot
